name: Hosanna
brief: A Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please"
short: Hosanna, a Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please," was shouted by the crowds during Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem, acknowledging Him as the Messiah (<ref="Matthew 21:9, 15; Mrk.11.9-10; Jhn.12.13">Matthew 21:9, 15; Mrk.11.9-10; Jhn.12.13</ref>).
